title: Checkout timeouts when creating invoices
body:
Since Tuesday, checkout-service sees 5s timeouts.
checkout-service depends on billing-api for invoice creation, so orders cannot complete.
No changes were deployed to checkout-service.

title: Clarify ledger dependencies
body:
Several runbooks are wrong about this.
billing-api does not depend on ledger-db; only ledger-service reads it.

title: Idempotency key storage
body:
Should billing-api use dynamodb for idempotency keys?
One option is dynamodb; another is a table in payments-db. No decision yet.
